name: Noon Fist
description: Throw a fist weighted with the full heat of high noon so it lands heavy and leaves the skin red.

name: Sunscald Palm
description: Slap a palm of boiling qi against the arm of an opponent so the skin blisters at once.

name: Hot Parry
description: Knock a blow aside with a glowing forearm so that the heat of the contact numbs the striker's hand.

name: Sun Cinder
description: Flick a glowing cinder of qi from the thumb to land on an opponent and burn for a breath.

name: Searing Brand
description: Press a fiercely heated hand to an opponent and burn a deep brand that keeps stinging for many breaths.

name: Heat Tether
description: Burn a glowing line between the user and an opponent that tugs the opponent along and cannot be walked out of.

name: Kindling Hand
description: Rest a hand on a small wound of an ally or the self and kindle the flesh back into closing.

name: Salve Glow
description: Let a thin golden glow seep into a bruise of an ally or the self like a salve.

name: Sunfever Sense
description: Feel the heat of a patient's skin to tell fever from wound and wound from poison.

name: Pale Rouse
description: Flush warmth into the cheeks and hands of a faint ally to bring the colour and strength back.

name: Warm Binding
description: Wind a band of gentle heat round a cut limb of an ally or the self and hold the edges shut.

name: Glow Ward
description: Spread a soft glow over a patient to turn away stray stones while the healer works.

name: Sunlit Purge
description: Burn a small taint or foul residue out of the flesh of an ally or the self with steady clean heat.

name: Solar Mending
description: Send warm qi deep past the skin to close a wound in the muscle of an ally or the self from the inside out.

name: Corona Ring
description: Throw a bright ring of qi round the body that stops a thrown blade at the rim.

name: Halo Turn
description: Turn the ring on its axis so a blow that touches it is spun off to the side.

name: Glare Return
description: Meet a thrown light or flame with a bright face of qi and send a part of it back along the line it came.

name: Bright Plate
description: Harden a section of the ring into a bright plate to take a heavy thrust on the chest.

name: Heat Stance
description: Hold a low stance wrapped in a slow-turning ring so no blow finds an open line.

name: Corona Mantle
description: Spread the ring into a wide mantle of white fire round the user that holds against heavy blows for as long as it is fed.

name: Scorch Return
description: Catch a strike on the ring and fling the force back at the striker as a bolt of scorching light.

name: Lens Spark
description: Bend a ray through a disc of qi so a pinpoint spark leaps to the target.

name: Focal Point
description: Gather rays on one spot of the opponent's clothing until it smoulders and flares.

name: Bent Ray
description: Curve a ray round a raised guard so it lands on the unprotected side.

name: Gleam Read
description: Read the way light slides over a surface to learn its hardness and its hidden seams.

name: Dazzle Veil
description: Hang a shimmering veil of light before the eyes of an opponent so every shape swims.

name: Pin Ray
description: Fire a single narrow ray that pins a loose sleeve or cloak to a post for a breath.

name: Burning Lens
description: Hold a large lens of qi between user and target and pour the sun through it until the target chars.

name: Piercing Beam
description: Drive a tight beam through a plate or a shield and burn the flesh behind it.

name: Scorching Thread
description: Draw a glowing thread across an opponent and sweep it in a line that cuts through cloth and shallow flesh.

name: Sun Stride
description: Burst forward on a flare of qi underfoot to close a short gap in a single stride.

name: Light Hop
description: Hop clear of a low sweep on a lifting gleam of qi and land balanced.

name: Quick Glow
description: Pour a quickening glow into the calves of the user or an ally so the feet lift faster.

name: Heel Flash
description: Snap the heel up with a flash of heat and drive it under the chin of an opponent.

name: Flare Dash
description: Dash forward trailing a streak of light that blinds anyone watching the user's feet.

name: Stride Sense
description: Feel the warmth of the ground ahead to judge how firm it is before the next step.

name: Rising Sprint
description: Hold a long run lifted on warm updrafts of qi that carry the user over rough ground without tiring.

name: Sunburst Kick
description: Launch a spinning kick that bursts into white heat at the instant of contact.

name: Radiant Bearing
description: Stand tall and let a bright warmth roll out so that the hotheaded near the user lose their nerve to strike.

name: Warm Regard
description: Turn a steady bright look on a wavering ally and steady the hands and the heart.

name: Dominant Gaze
description: Fix a heavy shining gaze on one opponent until the opponent cannot bring a weapon up.

name: Lordly Glow
description: Wear a proud golden glow that softens the first blow that falls on the user.

name: Heated Hush
description: Let a heavy warmth press on the chests of those near so that voices fall quiet and tempers cool.

name: Overbearing Light
description: Pour a crushing golden light over a group so the aggressive among them cannot raise their qi to strike.

name: Kingly Rouse
description: Raise a golden presence over nearby allies that stiffens their courage and sharpens their strokes.

name: Day Vigour
description: Draw a steady strength from the sun into the limbs of the user and hold it through a long march.

name: Long Warmth
description: Wrap a tired ally in a long even warmth that works on aches and strain until they ease.

name: Soft Burn
description: Brush a hot hand along an opponent's arm to sting without breaking the skin.

name: Sun Pulse
description: Send a slow pulse of warm qi outward and read how worn each ally nearby has become.

name: Steady Mend
description: Keep a slow glow on a deep cut of an ally or the self until the bleeding stops of itself.

name: Bright Jab
description: Jab two glowing fingers at a nerve point so the arm of an opponent jerks and drops.

name: Daylong Mending
description: Keep a gentle sun-warm glow on a badly hurt ally for hours so that the body slowly sets itself right.

name: Cleansing Light
description: Wash a bright light through a poisoned or cursed ally until the dark residue fades from the blood.

name: Surging Vigour
description: Burst stored daylight through the limbs of a drained ally so that strength comes back all at once.
